text:
maya: Quick proposal: small set of idempotent deploy helper scripts + a 'quick-resume' command for stalled rollouts. Goal: fewer manual rollbacks and clearer state.

trent: love it. can you sketch the UX? e.g., what commands does deploy-bot need?

maya: short list: `deploy start <tag>` (no change), `deploy resume <id>` (idempotent), `deploy verify <id>` (run smoke), and `deploy pin <service> <sha> --reason` (pin with audit). Also `deploy abort <id> --force` but only for emergencies.

zoe: we already have `deploy start` but not resume/verify. where do scripts live?

maya: proposal: new repo `deploy-tools` with tiny scripts + templates. snippets:

```bash
# idempotent resume example
set -e
DEPLOY_ID=$1
status=$(curl -fsS https://deploy/api/status/$DEPLOY_ID)
if [[ "$status" == "blocked" ]]; then
  curl -XPOST https://deploy/api/actions/$DEPLOY_ID/retry
else
  echo "no-op: $status"
fi
```

deploy-bot: FYI: I implemented `/deploy resume` on staging last week — needs auth + can only be used by `release-approvers` group. Logs: https://logs/deploy/2056789012

kai: Could we add a `--change-window` flag so resume aborts outside windows are gated? e.g., `--change-window=utc-02:00-06:00`

sagar: Prefer policy level in deploy-config so ops don't need flags. `resume` should check `allowed_windows` first and return actionable message.

maya: :thumbsup: Plan: I'll draft repo structure, add templates for release notes (template with checklist), add a short `deployctl resume` wrapper that does backoff and emits JIRA comment when resuming. Will PR in ~2d.

trent: Also add `--dry-run` to all operations and a `--why` prompt for pins so we get mandatory reason string.

zoe: If you add an annotation for pin reason, the console UI can show pins in diff view — +1 to mandatory reason.

maya: cool. I'll open RFC in docs, small demo in next release meeting. tagging @release-approvers for visibility.
